item.text: {"search_note":"I found no strong evidence that Putin treated human welfare as the core purpose of rule in 2023. The closest positive evidence is narrow crisis mitigation, POW-family access via the ICRC, and a few rescue/humanitarian responses. Those do not outweigh the dominant pattern of war mobilization, propaganda, repression, and patronage.","evidence":[{"title":"Russia-Ukraine international armed conflict: ICRC continues to help people in need","publisher":"ICRC","date":"14 Jun 2023","url":"https://www.icrc.org/en/document/russia-ukraine-international-armed-conflict-icrc-continues-to-help-people-in-need","summary":"The ICRC said it had visited more than 1,500 POWs and delivered family messages.
